big_chunks.title: Injector
heading_path: Engine Tuning Handbook - Acme Rocket Supply

small_chunks.text: Injector upgrades swap the stock nozzle plate for a machined manifold. The machined manifold atomizes fuel into a finer spray, which burns more evenly across the chamber and lifts thrust by a measurable margin on the Acme Rocket Supply test stand.

big_chunks.title: Turbopump
heading_path: Engine Tuning Handbook - Acme Rocket Supply

small_chunks.text: Turbopump balancing removes vibration at high spool speeds. Technicians spin each rotor on the balancing rig, add trim weights, and log the result before the pump returns to the Acme Rocket Supply assembly line.
